fusions.name: Couched Lance
fusions.desc: Couches the fork and drives it home, dealing 30 damage and leaving the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Trample Line
fusions.desc: A thundering sweep that deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks each back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Thunder Rise
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5s after you use it.

fusions.name: Drumming Heart
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
